question_text: Some people believe that computers and the internet have made learning easier, while others think students have become too dependent on technology. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some people think that protecting the environment is the responsibility of governments, while others believe individuals should take action. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some people believe that prisons should focus on punishing criminals, while others think the main purpose should be to rehabilitate them. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
The number of people eating fast food is increasing worldwide. What are the causes of this trend, and what effects does it have on individuals and society?
More people are working from home due to advances in technology. Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?
As countries become more globalized, some believe that traditional cultures and customs are being lost. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people think governments should spend more money on public services such as healthcare and education, rather than on the arts. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
More and more people are moving from rural areas to cities. What are the reasons for this, and what problems does it cause in urban areas?
Social media has a significant influence on young people's opinions and behaviour. Do you think this influence is more positive or negative?
In many countries, both parents work full-time and children are cared for by relatives or childcare services. Is this a positive or negative development?
Tourism has become one of the world's largest industries. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this development for local communities?
Advances in artificial intelligence and automation mean that many jobs currently done by humans could be done by machines in the future. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
Some people think everyone should go to university, while others believe some people are better suited to vocational training. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Climate change is one of the biggest threats facing the world today. What are the main causes of climate change, and what measures can governments and individuals take to address it?
In many developed countries, the population is aging rapidly. What problems does this cause, and what solutions can be suggested?
Many people find it difficult to balance their work and personal lives. What are the causes of this problem, and what can be done to solve it?
In many countries, crime rates among young people are increasing. What do you think are the causes of this, and what solutions can you suggest?
Some people think governments should spend money on space exploration, while others believe this money should be spent on more urgent problems on Earth. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Advertising is everywhere and influences the way people think and behave. Do the disadvantages of advertising outweigh the advantages?
Some people believe that boys and girls should be taught in separate schools, while others think they should study together. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Plastic waste is a growing environmental problem. What are the causes of this problem, and what measures could be taken to reduce it?
Mental health problems among young people are increasing. What are the reasons for this, and what can be done to address it?
Unemployment is a serious problem in many countries, especially among young people. What are the causes of youth unemployment, and what solutions can be suggested?
Children today spend more time using screens (phones, tablets, computers) than in the past. Is this a positive or negative development?

Some people believe that increased surveillance, such as CCTV cameras in public places, helps reduce crime, while others think it is an invasion of privacy. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
In some cultures, grandparents play a major role in raising children. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this arrangement?
Some wealthy individuals are now able to travel to space as tourists. Do you think this is a positive or negative use of resources?
Some people believe that students should not be given homework, while others think homework is essential for learning. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some people think the best way to tackle climate change is to switch entirely to renewable energy sources, while others believe this is not realistic. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Some people believe that healthcare should be free for everyone, while others think people should pay for their own medical care. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
In many cities, tall buildings are replacing traditional houses. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend?
The spread of false information (fake news) on the internet is a growing concern. What problems does this cause, and how can it be addressed?
An increasing number of people are working as freelancers rather than having permanent jobs. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this trend?
Divorce rates have increased significantly in many countries. What do you think are the reasons for this, and what effects does it have on children?

Some people think historical buildings and monuments should be preserved at all costs, while others believe money would be better spent on new development. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Online shopping is becoming increasingly popular and is replacing traditional shopping in physical stores. Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
Some people believe that exams are not an effective way to assess students' abilities, while others think they are necessary. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Forests are being cut down at an alarming rate around the world. What are the causes of deforestation, and what can be done to prevent it?
Obesity rates are rising in many countries. What are the main causes of this trend, and what measures can be taken to reduce it?
Some countries are increasing the age at which people can retire. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
Some people believe that financial crimes committed by businesspeople should be punished as severely as violent crimes. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people think governments should invest more in public transport rather than building new roads for private cars. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Some people believe that television has a negative effect on children, while others think it can be educational. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
In the past, extended families living together was common, but nowadays nuclear families are more common. What are the reasons for this change, and is it a positive or negative development?
Ecotourism is becoming more popular as travellers seek more sustainable ways to explore nature. What are the benefits and drawbacks of this type of tourism?
As technology develops, companies and governments are able to collect more personal data about individuals. Do you think this is a positive or negative development?
Some people believe that learning a foreign language should be compulsory in schools, while others think it should be optional. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
Many animal species are at risk of extinction. What are the reasons for this, and what can be done to protect endangered species?
Some governments have introduced taxes on sugary drinks and unhealthy food to combat rising obesity rates. Do you think this is an effective solution?
In the future, robots may be used to care for elderly people instead of human caregivers. Do you think the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?
